basics.name: Jeong-woo Han
basics.label: Full-stack Robotics Engineer · Research Associate, University of Waterloo
basics.summary: Robotics engineer and researcher working across mechanical design, embedded systems, and full-stack robot software (ROS/ROS2). Ph.D. from the University of Waterloo; experience spans mobile robot navigation, mobile manipulation, dual-arm robot control, and medical robotics.

work.name: University of Waterloo
work.position: Research Associate, Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering
work.summary: Developing a robotic HIFU (high-intensity focused ultrasound) treatment system. Part-time from May 2025; full-time since July 2026.

work.name: Mirsee Robotics Inc.
work.summary: Real-time motion planning and control for the dual arms of a humanoid robot.
highlights: Real-time dual-arm motion planning and control: Jacobian-based custom solver for position/velocity control and real-time servoing, including testing and debugging
MoveIt-based path planning (time-parameterized trajectories) and control logic
Custom multi-axis EtherCAT ROS2 slave driver plugin (URDF-based); core maintainer of the company's ROS2 repository
Autonomous pick-and-place framework development, including off-the-shelf YOLO-based object recognition
Core contributor to public demos (Discovery X 2026, CTV News pick-and-place demo)

work.name: University of Waterloo
work.position: Research Associate, Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering
highlights: Manufacturing-AI project manager
Planning and control interfaces of a 6DOF parallel robotic manipulator
High-level controller for a mobile manipulator

work.name: Hyundai Heavy Industries, Medical Robotics Institute
work.summary: Led development of MORNING WALK, an end-effector type gait rehabilitation robot, from scratch to commercialization.
highlights: Full (100%) hardware design contribution over 3 years: concept through detailed design, with dynamics analysis for actuator selection and link structural analysis
Korean FDA (now MFDS) medical device certification and installation in rehabilitation hospitals
Transitioned to control software engineering for 2 years: GUI and control-logic improvements
Promoted to Lead Researcher one year early based on contribution to the robot's development
Dissertation: Safe and Efficient Navigation of a Mobile Robot: Path Planning Based on Hierarchical Topology Map and Motion Planning with Pedestrian Behavior Model
Independently developed a custom 7-DOF inverse kinematics solver and prepared a mobile-manipulator pick-and-place demo for PackExpo within two months

Thesis: Design and Hardware Validation using CoP of Walking Assistive Lower Limb Exoskeleton for Paraplegia Patient — full hardware design and fabrication of the exoskeleton, including a DSP-based sensor/communication board, and CoP-based estimation of user walking intent

Concurrent graduate research: exoskeleton foot module design (with GRF sensor), a UAV safety unit and circular-path control algorithm (DSP-based), and a strain-gauge-based smart bed for patient fall detection (custom amplifier board and Arduino)

Pedestrian behavior model
